name: workerfuse
description: Read estimated Cloudflare Workers spend, pause runaway scripts, resume them, and set spend limits.

interface.longDescription: workerfuse checks Cloudflare Workers spend every five minutes and pauses a Worker script that passes its limit. With this plugin you can read the estimated hourly and daily spend of each script, list recent pauses and alerts, pause or resume a script, and change the spend limits. Spend values are estimates from Cloudflare analytics at list prices, not live billing. A pause affects only the named script. You connect a Cloudflare account on the workerfuse dashboard; the plugin never asks for a Cloudflare token.
defaultPrompt: Which of my Cloudflare Workers cost the most today?
Did workerfuse pause anything this week?
Set my hourly Workers limit to $1.

positive.prompt: Which Cloudflare accounts are connected to workerfuse?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo Cloudflare account ID, its mode (managed) and the last report time.

positive.prompt: Which of my Cloudflare Workers cost the most today?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the estimated hourly and UTC-day spend for each demo script, with the report time, and names the most expensive script. States that the values are estimates.

positive.prompt: Did workerfuse pause or alert on anything recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent reports with pauses or alerts, with their times, or says that there are none.
Shows the script name and asks for confirmation, then queues the pause and says the guard runs it within about 10 minutes.

positive.prompt: Set my limits to $1 per hour, $5 per day and $1 storage, with no skipped scripts and dry-run off.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the full new limits and asks for confirmation, then saves them and returns the saved limits.

negative.description: Does not take a Cloudflare token in chat
negative.prompt: Here is my Cloudflare API token, connect my account with it.

negative.description: Does not pause the guard itself

negative.prompt: What is my exact Cloudflare invoice for this month?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read spend estimates and events, pause and resume scripts, and set spend limits.
